notes: Tool-level wall times only; overlapping calls are unioned for androidBusyMs.
Summary sorted by all-attempt wallTotalMs; failedMs includes errors, timeouts, not-found and cancellation. Distribution statistics and totalMs are success-only; stage totals may overlap.
Unobserved time includes model work, user pauses, other tools and orchestration; it is not an LLM-latency measurement.
No arguments, results, selectors, screen text, device serials or credentials are retained.
Failure counts describe explicit error/timeout/not-found results, not inferred retries. Cache hits and ADB reconnect internals are unknown.
